differential.name: End‑stage renal disease on hemodialysis (awaiting kidney transplant)
differential.rationale: Creatinine 2.1 mg/dL, pre‑/post‑dialysis weight loss of 3.7 kg and CKD stages 1‑3 indicate progression to ESRD with dialysis dependence.

differential.name: Ischemic heart disease (stable coronary artery disease)
differential.rationale: Documented IHD, hypertension, diabetes and abnormal cardiac imaging findings make coronary disease highly likely.

differential.name: Obstructive sleep apnea syndrome
differential.rationale: Listed as an active disorder; OSA is common in middle‑aged, obese, hypertensive patients and contributes to cardiovascular strain.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease / iron‑deficiency anemia
differential.rationale: Chronic kidney disease, diabetes, and ongoing dialysis often cause anemia; anemia is flagged among active conditions.

differential.name: Non‑alcoholic fatty liver disease (NASH)
differential.rationale: Mildly elevated ALT (59 U/L) with normal AST, diabetes, and metabolic syndrome suggest NAFLD as the source of liver enzyme elevation.
